sections: Pore structure and surface area of silica SBA-15: influence of washing and scale-up
Results and Discussion Template removal by washing with a single solvent
Influence of combined washing with ethanol and water
Influence of scaling up on the washing effect

figures.caption: Figure 1: N2 adsorption/desorption isotherms of SBA-15 unwashed ( 1A ), after washing with 30 mL ethanol ( 1B ) and 30 mL water ( 1C ). The isotherms are offset by 450 ( 1A ) and 300 ( 1B ) cm 3 /g.

Figure 2: NLDFT pore size distributions of SBA-15 unwashed ( 1A ), after washing with 30 mL ethanol ( 1B ) and 30 mL water ( 1C ) calculated from the adsorption branch of the isotherm. The pore size distributions are offset by 0.06 ( 1A ) and 0.03 ( 1B ) cm 3 /Å/g.

Figure 3: Small angle XRD of SBA-15 unwashed ( 1A ), after washing with 30 mL ethanol ( 1B ) and 30 mL water ( 1C ). The intensities are normalized to the (100) reflection and offset by 0.4 ( 1A ) and 0.2 ( 1B ).

Figure 4: N2 adsorption/desorption isotherms of SBA-15 unwashed ( 2A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 2B ) and 30 mL ( 2C ) quantities of solvent. The isotherms are offset by 350 ( 2A ) and 50 ( 2B ) cm 3 /g.

Figure 5: NLDFT pore size distribution of SBA-15 unwashed ( 2A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 2B ) and 30 mL ( 2C ) quantities of solvent calculated from the adsorption branch of the isotherm. The pore size distributions are offset by 0.05 ( 2A ) and 0.025 ( 2B ) cm 3 /Å/g.

Figure 6: NLDFT pore size distribution of SBA-15 unwashed ( 2A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 2B ) and 30 mL ( 2C ) quantities of solvent calculated from the desorption branch of the isotherm. The pore size distributions are offset by 0.5 ( 2A ) and 0.25 ( 2B ) cm 3 /Å/g.

Figure 7: Small angle XRD of SBA-15 unwashed ( 2A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 2B ) and 30 mL ( 2C ) quantities of solvent. The intensities are normalized to the (100) reflection and offset by 0.4 ( 2A ) and 0.2 ( 2B ).

Figure 8: N2 adsorption/desorption isotherms of SBA-15 sample 3 devided into a 1× half batch unwashed ( 3A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 3B ) and 30 mL ( 3C ), a 3× half batch washed with 120 mL ( 3D ) and a 9× half batch washed with 350 mL ( 3E ) quantities of solvent. The isotherms are offset by 1100 ( 3A ), 700 ( 3B ), 500 ( 3C ), 300 ( 3D ) cm 3 /g.

Figure 9: NLDFT pore size distribution of SBA-15 sample 3 calculated from the adsorption branch of the isotherm. The sample was devided into a 1× half batch unwashed ( 3A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 3B ) and 30 mL ( 3C ), a 3× half batch washed with 120 mL ( 3D ) and a 9× half batch washed with 350 mL ( 3E ) quantities of solvent. The pore size distributions are offset by 0.16 ( 3A ), 0.12 ( 3B ), 0.08 ( 3C ) and 0.04 ( 3D ) cm 3 /Å/g.

Figure 10: XRD of SBA-15 sample 3 devided into a 1× half batch unwashed ( 3A ), after washing with 5 mL ( 3B ) and 30 mL ( 3C ), a 3× half batch washed with 120 mL ( 3D ) and a 9× half batch washed with 350 mL ( 3E ) quantities of solvent. The intesities are normalized to the (100) reflection and offset by 0.8 ( 3A ), 0.6 ( 3B ), 0.4 ( 3C ) and 0.2 ( 3D ). Note: Oscillations are an artefact in the measurement.
Figure 11: Effect of narrowed pores in the SBA-15 structure on the isotherm shape.
